reason: Each test drives Playwright's trace viewer internals directly, with no browser: `SnapshotRenderer` (the viewer's DOM snapshot renderer, with its escaping and its nonce), `LRUCache`, and `stripAnsiEscapes`. Strider exports traces that Playwright's viewer reads and has no renderer of its own to test, so the viewer's escaping (TV-123 to TV-133), its screencast frame choice (TV-136), and its ANSI helper (TV-134, TV-135) are the viewer's, not Strider's
